addr: 702, WOC Road, Rajaji Nagar, Opp to Bharat petrol bunk, below kanti sweets, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560086, India

rev.t:
Got good collection of books (second hand books as well).. The staff is very polite..You get to explore books from different genres..
They have good collections of kids books, educational books as well ..Definitely a go to spot for book lovers...

A good and decent book house in and around Rajajinagar. You get all the genres of books here. Some books are sold with discounts in price and also the educational books related to Engineering and competitive exams are sold according to the …
Very nice place for book worms, but I felt very limited kannada book collection than english and others
